# Color Pattern

## Design tokens

| Token                    | Value         | Usage                          |
| ------------------------ | ------------- | ------------------------------ |
| Page background          | `#0A0A0F`     | All page backgrounds           |
| Card surface             | `#16161F`     | All card backgrounds           |
| Inner / input background | `#111118`     | Inputs, chrome bar, row hovers |
| Border                   | `#2A2A3A`     | All borders                    |
| Primary action           | `#E8A838`     | All CTA buttons                |
| Heading text             | `#F5F0E8`     | All headings                   |
| Body text                | `#7A7890`     | All secondary text             |
| Label text               | `#B8B5C5`     | Form labels                    |
| Error                    | `#E05555`     | All error states               |
| Card radius              | `rounded-2xl` | All cards                      |
